title: PowerToys Not detecting updates automatically or manually

judgment.rationale: The report needs a current updater diagnostic and exact comparison with the latest published release before a code fix can be selected.
evidence: Both automatic and manual in-app update detection reportedly fail.
The reporter previously had to download an installer manually.

fix_assessment.rationale: The current report does not identify whether update discovery, channel selection, or network access is failing.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys 0.101.2362 installed from GitHub reports that it is up to date even when the reporter selects the update area, while manually downloading the installer was required on the previous version. The report does not include the update channel, network result, or diagnostic data.
known_information: Both automatic and manual in-app update detection reportedly fail.
The reporter previously had to download an installer manually.
inferences: The updater may be reading a stale channel/version, failing release metadata access, or suppressing updates because of install/package context.
The issue could be environmental network/proxy or a release timing mismatch rather than an updater code defect.
issue_context.analysis: The report needs a current updater diagnostic and exact comparison with the latest published release before a code fix can be selected.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete report and confirmed there are no comments or diagnostic ZIP.
Separated release metadata/channel, network access, and updater state as the main discriminators.

information_gaps.information: A fresh diagnostic package after manually selecting the update check
information_gaps.why_needed: Provides updater logs and the detected channel/version.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Select the update check and comment /bugreport immediately afterward.

information_gaps.information: The latest PowerToys release version visible on the GitHub Releases page and the version shown by the in-app check
information_gaps.why_needed: Confirms whether the app is comparing against the correct release/channel.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with both versions and the exact date/time of the check.

information_gaps.information: Whether a proxy, firewall, VPN, or security product can block GitHub release metadata
information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguishes environmental access failure from updater logic.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Report whether the same machine can open the GitHub release page and whether disabling only the suspected network filter changes the check.

comment.body:
Thanks for reporting both failed automatic detection and the need to install the previous update manually. The remaining gap is whether PowerToys is checking the wrong channel/version or cannot retrieve GitHub release metadata.

Please provide:

1. Select the in-app update check and comment `/bugreport` immediately afterward.
2. Reply with the latest version shown on the GitHub Releases page, the version shown by PowerToys, and the approximate time of the check.
3. Confirm whether the same machine can open the GitHub release page and whether a proxy, VPN, firewall, or security product filters GitHub access.

This will distinguish updater logic from release-channel or network access failure.
